review: The previous goal turn restored shared native calls in eighty card owners and Takklemaggot's missing removal path; that was verified progress. This pass restores fifteen additional mechanic delegations and checks selected event predicates directly against native instructions.

Convoke cards reuse generic_spell_with_convoke after their keyword/devour effects. Hybrid cards reuse hybrid after their individual effects. Wizards Retort reuses Counterspell; Censor reuses Force Spike; Haze of Pollen reuses Fog; Urborg Skeleton reuses Drudge Skeletons. Existing helper definitions remain unchanged.

Iron Will uses the casting-event predicate to choose between its native pump and us_cycling helpers. Rift Sower chooses suspend for casting/cost events and its native mana-creature helper otherwise. Their two compiler-shaped gotos and expanded cost/color logic are removed.

Teach by Example has three native routes, verified from raw code: basic_spell on EVENT_CAN_CAST, card_doublecast on EVENT_RESOLVE_SPELL, hybrid otherwise. A three-argument public card helper declaration is added to manalink.h. Doublecast is reused only for its resolution subset; its historical whole-function comparison score is not treated as exact.

The Ikoria counter predicate now calls count_counters(player,card,-1), preserving the complete numeric return and activation-parent handling. COUNTER_ANY is a different enum selector and is deliberately not substituted for -1. Raw aliased counter-byte accesses are removed.

The token-haste callback restores add_status with the native target-player/legacy slot and STATUS_INVISIBLE_FX (0x10000). Native/rebuilt token-record sizes and three accessed field offsets agree; four controller combinations verify the actual outgoing status operands after an explicitly stubbed legacy allocation.

The native event_t has 154 names and 149 distinct values. Each of five route selectors is executed up to its selected helper for 322 distinct native/neighboring/sentinel event integers, two players and four affected-card/controller combinations: 12,880 native/current comparisons. Full outgoing operands agree, including cycling, pump and suspend costs. This is a bounded dispatch check, not execution of the gameplay helpers.

Shape of the Wiitigo's physical blocking call is behind an outer event gate that excludes EVENT_DECLARE_BLOCKERS. Three physical land-sound calls are similarly unreachable on EVENT_RESOLVE_SPELL; the real path delegates to mana_producer. Native/current path execution confirms these facts without enabling the dead actions or replacing the real fallback.

One combined build, all 15,169 fixed slots and eleven complete source-file projections pass. Fifteen reused helper definitions remain unchanged. Existing staging is preserved; no post-edit full similarity or transitive gameplay-equivalence claim is made.

The post-batch full report covers all 18,828 configured ranges and verifies all 160 explicit function-address bindings plus 293 live data bindings.
